about: Danya Cebus Ltd. operates as a construction and infrastructure company in Israel and internationally. It undertakes infrastructure projects, including road paving, building railway infrastructure, construction of bridges, parking lots, tunnel mining, and associated infrastructure development, as well as commercial, industrial, and residential infrastructures. The company also engages in the design and execution of integrated electromechanical systems; concrete pumps array, lease of tower cranes, external elevators services, and skyscrapers and building equipment; residential projects for rent
